trials.name: libxsmm-n512-panel32-one-streaming-region
trials.hypothesis: Reuse the panel32 packing and compute body for sixteen row panels inside one SME region with one 64 KiB scratch allocation. Saved registers x21/x22/x23 retain B/A/C bases, x26 retains scratch, x27 counts panels, and x28 holds the byte offset; these registers are saved and restored by the existing prologue and epilogue and are otherwise unused by the supplied helper body. Each panel resets B, A, C, scratch and the packing cursor. A and C advance by 65536 bytes, covering all 512 output rows once. SP resets to scratch after packing and returns to the saved stack top after the last panel. The FP32 K loop, ZA setup, output stores, general-size fallback and complete license notices remain unchanged. This differs from the measured sixteen-call wrapper. Reduced entry/exit overhead is an unverified hypothesis; comparison against full512 measures the complete layout and control-flow change and cannot isolate transition costs. No tools or tests were run. Compilation, full-GEMM correctness and fresh repeated paired performance validation remain required under the unchanged gates and initial power settings. No speedup or throughput above 1800 GFLOP/s is established.

adjudication.reason:
Recorded correctness passed at tolerance 0.002, but eligible=false prohibits adoption. Retain the imported incumbent unchanged and preserve eb091b1e… as the user-selected panel32 research source.

Across ten runs, the candidate scored 747.82–1047.04 GFLOP/s versus paired controls of 596.91–1064.69. It won 4/10 pairs. Candidate and control spreads were 299.23 and 467.78 GFLOP/s. Its minimum fails the required >1117.93 GFLOP/s threshold (1.05 × maximum paired control). These overlapping, variable results establish no repeatable gain or cause.

The candidate exceeded the fresh initial baseline peak of 1079.8626 and paired-control peak of 1064.6919 in 0/10 runs each. Separately, it exceeded the saved Battery Automatic peak of 1668.5964359101147, AC initial peak of 1685.6230608449698, and later AC control peak of 1687.3925479742732 in 0/10 runs each. Historical modes remain separate and do not enter eligibility. The consistency goal is unmet; comparator policy remains pending. No holdout result is supplied.

Next implementation must follow the specialist-ranked board and make a distinct change to the active panel32 path under the unchanged gates and budgets. This replay supplies repeatability evidence, not a new optimization. No individual advisor effect, GEMM gain from calibration, or hardware ceiling is established.

trials.name: libxsmm-panel32-next-operands-before-branch
trials.hypothesis: Implement the selected software pipeline in the active panel32 K loop, starting from eb091b1e…. A prologue loads K=0. Each of 511 loop iterations updates ZA0–ZA3, loads the next operands into the same registers, advances the pointers, and branches. A final drain updates all four tiles for K=511 without another load. This preserves 512 loads per operand stream, pointer totals, and each output's FP32 accumulation order without register copies or extra accumulators. Placing loads before loop control tests load-latency overlap; benefit is unverified. This active-panel32 change is absent from the supplied measured history. Packing, allocation, stores, ABI, stack handling, fallback and all BSD notices remain unchanged. No tools or tests were run. Compilation, all 48 public cases at tolerance 0.002, ten validation reports, ten alternating fresh imported controls, the fixed promotion gate and holdout validation remain required. No throughput or repeatability gain is established.
